17 booster sets from White Wolf, at 396 cards per display box and 10 boxes per set = 67,320 cards.

To get to 300,000 you have to buy almost 50 display boxes per release.

That is amazing dedication.

That is more cards than most cities buy, much less individual players.

www.thelasombra.com/lists/booster_distribution.txt

Jyhad/V:TES = 684 cards per box (19*36)
Dark Sovereigns = 540 cards per box (15*36)
Ancient Hearts = 540 cards per box (12*45)
Sabbat = 672 cards per box (28*24)
All 17 White Wolf releases = 396 cards per box (11*36)
